meta.title: A vendor must not receive other vendors' individual price limits
gaps: The available operations do not expose individual vendor price limits in the vendor's bidding-screen response. This plan verifies the closest available privacy boundary: the QA vendor is refused access to the second vendor's bid, rather tha
what the screen shows (an API plan checks the data, not the page)

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with two QA vendors invited, each with a submitted bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer sets the invited vendor's price cap on the round to 120 (a bid must be strictly below it) for the invited QA vendor.
The buyer sets the invited vendor's price cap on the round to 105 (a bid must be strictly below it) for a second QA vendor.
The invited QA vendor reads the second QA vendor's bid.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to view this event.”, and never with a server error.
